response: No, pneumologists' skepticism is not justified. Chemotherapy has been shown to improve survival and quality of life in patients with advanced non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC). Numerous clinical trials have demonstrated that chemotherapy can prolong survival, reduce symptoms, and improve overall well-being in patients with advanced NSCLC. While the benefits of chemotherapy may vary depending on individual patient factors, such as performance status and tumor histology, the overall evidence supports the use of chemotherapy as a treatment option for advanced NSCLC.
